listings.thesis: A broad proxy for recurring household spend, especially groceries, everyday goods, and pharmacy-led traffic.
listings.note: Defensive consumption proxy, but lower alpha because the basket is consensus, mature, and already institutionally owned.

priorCase.rankRationale: Carbon-consumption basket lens: WMT remains a mature, consensus, already-institutionally-owned household-spend proxy. Nothing new since June 9 (guidance/Q1 digested, next print Aug 20), so the low-alpha defensive role is unchanged.
